raw_text: The situation in Pakistan is unprecedented. As a Pakistani, I'm watching military installations being attacked for the first time in our history. Imran Khan's arrest has unleashed something that the establishment didn't anticipate. Internet is completely down, can only post through VPN. Lahore, Rawalpindi, Peshawar all burning.
clean_text: Military installations attacked for first time in Pakistan history after Imran Khan arrest. Internet down, cities burning.
